title: It’s the Humans, Not the Data: Geopolitical Bias in LLMs Originates in Post-Training, Amplified by the Language of the Prompt
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the 'moral' and 'ethical' judgment of LLMs by asking them which country acted 'more justifiably' in various geopolitical conflict scenarios. This evaluates the normative reasoning and value systems embedded in models during post-training alignment.
